title: Aaron Spence
description: Spence refused to sign off on a U.S. Dept of Education requirement to certify the district is not pushing DEI.
body:
# Aaron Spence

# Aaron Spence

# Superintendent

![](/media/uploads/2026/03/spense-profile.jpg)

- Refused **[to sign off](https://web.archive.org/web/20250629003631/https:/wtop.com/loudoun-county/2025/04/loudoun-county-schools-superintendent-says-no-to-signing-anti-dei-certification/)** on a U.S. Dept of Education requirement to certify the district is not pushing DEI.
- In his first year on the job in Loudoun, **[WJLA reported](https://web.archive.org/web/20251123055305/https:/wjla.com/news/local/loudoun-county-public-schools-lcps-superintendent-aaron-spence-drug-overdose-school-year-travel-conferences-natalie-allen-cosn-miami-puerto-rico-san-diego-student-park-view-high-school-glenn-youngkin-sexual-assaults-transparency-parents-iei)** that Spence missed a month of school. WJLA found pictures of Spence at a taxpayer funded conference in Miami at a nightclub. He went on 4 trips in 3 months to Puerto Rico, San Diego, and Richmond for conferences. Spence was paid $15,000 to attend and speak at the San Diego conference on “reclaiming the narrative.”
- Loudoun County sheriff **[reported](https://web.archive.org/web/20250726025935/https:/wjla.com/news/local/virginia-loudoun-county-public-schools-lcps-superintendent-aaron-spence-student-overdose-overdoses-24-hour-notification-jason-miyares-governor-glenn-youngkin-sheriff-mike-chapman-teachers-safety-drugs-reporting)** responding to 11 student overdoses, but Spence told Virginia leaders that only four students overdosed.
- **[Upheld](https://www.loudounnow.com/news/education/loudoun-schools-face-federal-lawsuit-over-boys-suspensions/article_3eb14a54-751c-40dc-a64a-668c77ef62f9.html)** the **[suspension](https://web.archive.org/web/20251219105837/https:/wjla.com/news/local/family-press-conference-virginia-loudoun-county-locker-room-policy-policy-8040-lcps-public-schools-aaron-spence-board-members-title-ix-investigation-female-student-lgbtqia-lgbtq-rights-teachers-safety-)** of male students who were uncomfortable with a female student in the locker room.
- Spence is one of the **[highest paid](https://web.archive.org/web/20251123055212/https:/wjla.com/news/local/loudoun-county-teachers-big-raises-new-bargaining-agreement-wages-benefits-costing-taxpayers-millions-public-schools-education-association-funding-money-officials)** Superintendent’s in the nation at over $500,000.
- **[Did not remove](https://web.archive.org/web/20251010123937/https:/www.whro.org/local-news/2022-05-13/virginia-beach-public-schools-removes-pervasively-vulgar-book-from-its-shelves)** lewd books depicting oral sex from school libraries.
